links.comparator_used: Nonpilot APPs in the same organization documenting without the AI scribe (non-randomized, descriptive comparison)
links.outcome: Time spent in the note writer and same-day encounter closure
links.effect: Note writer time: mean 6 min (SD 2.2; median 6, IQR 5.0-8.0) in the pilot group vs mean 14 min (SD 11.2; median 11, IQR 8.4-18.5) in nonpilot APPs. Same-day encounter closure: 90% (7290/8100) vs 72% (23,682/32,983).
links.tradeoff: Use was optional and varied by APP, from 30% to 89% of encounters (66.7% overall). APPs kept a mean of 78% of AI-generated note content (range 20%-93%), so edits were still needed. The comparison was descriptive with limited generalizability.
links.quote: The time spent in the note writer for the pilot group was a mean 6 (SD 2.2; median 6, IQR 5.0-8.0) minutes vs a mean 14 (SD 11.2; median 11, IQR 8.4-18.5) minutes for nonpilot APPs.

design_hint: labor union engagement and pilot testing
